independence_declaration.statement: I am code-security-reviewer, session 20f82359. I authored no implementation in the DG2 scope, including FE13 29da00d (frontend-ux-engineer) and D-075 ed80b23 (delivery-orchestrator). I reviewed the frozen candidate directly: the product diff ea9051b..ed80b23 (6 files, all under apps/web) and the full files it touches, plus LoginPage, Shell sign-out, LanguageSwitch and the pages whose success handlers write to the query cache. I ran code only in disposable clones under $TMPDIR ($TMPDIR/review-r15 for the checks, $TMPDIR/r15p for the probes and load, both at 9236a9f) and on disposable PostgreSQL 16 clusters, all deleted afterwards. I wrote nothing in source paths; my probes live in my evidence directory. I formed this verdict without reading any other reviewer's round-15 record or evidence.

checks_run.procedure: Review the product changes since round 14 and the full files they touch: client.ts (session phase, reset hooks, identity key), queries.ts fetchMe, App.tsx resetSessionCache/createQueryClient, session.tsx RequireSession (claim removed, person-keyed subtree), plus LoginPage, Shell sign-out and LanguageSwitch, which call fetchMe. Also grep the added lines. The assignment names the range fe22d759..cbdb4f68, but those are the round-10/11 commits D-070 and D-071, already reviewed in rounds 11-14. The round-14 candidate's source was ea9051b, so the product change since round 14 is ea9051b..ed80b23, and that is what I reviewed. diff-scan.log records the stat of both ranges.
checks_run.command: git diff ea9051b..ed80b23 -- apps packages; git diff --stat ea9051b..ed80b23 -- . ':!docs'; added-line grep scan (diff-scan.log)
checks_run.expected: No weakening of sign-in, sign-out, CSRF, OIDC returnTo, the bilingual messages, or FE10/FE11/FE12; no new XSS sink, CDN, secret or open redirect.
checks_run.actual: 6 files, all under apps/web (client.ts, queries.ts, App.tsx, session.tsx, one unit test file and one e2e spec); no API, database or contract change. CSRF: endSession still clears the in-memory token before announcing the end. The identity key embeds the CSRF token only in module memory and never persists or logs it. The diff scan's 6 hits are this key and its comments; all are benign. returnTo: safeReturnTo (LoginPage.tsx:32) and sessionEndedLoginPath are unchanged. FE10: RequireSession still navigates once (redirected ref), disables /me while ended and renders nothing for an ended session. isSessionEndedError is unchanged (401 `unauthenticated` only), so a 403 never ends a session. Sign-out still calls markSignedOut, cancelQueries and clear() (Shell.tsx:51-53). FE11/FE12 render-time translation is untouched. The new person-keyed Fragment remounts only on another org/user; a new session of the same person keeps their drafts by design. One residual of the F-DG2-500 class is raised as a new finding (SEC-R15-20, F-DG2-530): success handlers that call setQueryData after an awaited api.send are not covered by the reset. Exit 0.

checks_run.procedure: Probe the F-DG2-500 class with a new probe (users A and B differ in user id AND session). Cases: X2 Back/Forward after an identity change; X3 an in-flight edit (PATCH) answered after an identity change; X3b the same after a session end in this tab and B's sign-in; X4 an in-flight query answered after an identity change; X6 observation of a refocus within /me's 60 s staleTime; X7 403 csrf on a PATCH. Plus a source sweep for other carriers: localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, service worker, BroadcastChannel, module singletons and setQueryData call sites.
checks_run.command: pnpm vitest run --project unit-web apps/web/src/auth/zz-sec-r15-web-probe.test.tsx (probe-runs.sh); grep -rn 'localStorage|sessionStorage|indexedDB|BroadcastChannel|serviceWorker|setQueryData' apps/web/src
checks_run.environment: Probe clone $TMPDIR/r15p at 9236a9f; Node 22.22.2 LANG unset, and Node 24.21.0 LANG=C.UTF-8; jsdom; SYNTHETIC data; probe sha256 bd97dbc9
checks_run.expected: No case shows A's data to B.
checks_run.actual: Exit 1 on both runtimes, BY DESIGN, with exactly one failing assertion: X3 `expect(cached?.name).toBeUndefined()` received 'A-PATCHED-SECRET'. A's edit, answered after B's identity arrived, is written into the cache by TransformationEditPage's success handler (setQueryData), and B is navigated to it and sees it, even after B's own refetch answers 404 (new finding F-DG2-530, Low). The other 5 cases pass on both runtimes. X2: B never sees A's record after Back/Back/Forward. X3b: the late write after a session END is removed at B's /me. X4: A's late query answer never lands. X7: a 403 csrf PATCH is not an end. X6 is an observation that always passes: within /me's staleTime a refocus refetches page queries with the new cookie but not /me, so the tab shows A's name with B's own rows. That shows the cookie holder's own data and not A's, so it is not raised. Sweep: localStorage holds only the locale and the column-visibility preferences; there is no sessionStorage, IndexedDB, service worker or BroadcastChannel. The only module singletons are the CSRF token, the phase and the identity key, all reset. No stderr in either log.

checks_run.procedure: Verify F-DG2-500 (Medium) on this candidate: the session-scoped cache is cleared where the session ends, whatever is mounted, and an identity change purges every session query before rendering.
checks_run.command: SEC-R15-17 + SEC-R15-19 + source reading (client.ts endSession/runSessionReset, App.tsx createQueryClient/resetSessionCache, queries.ts fetchMe)
checks_run.expected: W5/W5b pass; clearing does not depend on <RequireSession>; an identity change removes A's queries before B renders.
checks_run.actual: Genuine. endSession runs the reset hook synchronously before the phase is announced. The hook is registered with the QueryClient at creation, so it works on the sign-in page. W5/W5b pass on Node 22 and 24, and FE13's own tests pass in the unit runs. The identity change at fetchMe removes all non-'me' queries and remounts the subtree for another person (X2, X4). F-DG2-500 -> CLOSED_VERIFIED (verifications sidecar). The late-write residual (X3) is a different mechanism and is tracked as the new Low finding F-DG2-530.

summary: PASS with one new Low finding that is not a mandatory violation (F-DG2-530). F-DG2-500 is genuinely fixed and verified CLOSED. The session-end reset now runs inside the API client wherever the session ends, and my round-14 W5/W5b leak is gone on Node 22 and 24. An identity change at /me purges every session query before B renders, and Back/Forward and late query answers carry nothing across. FE10's guarantees hold: one navigation, bounded requests, no stale shell, a 403 is never an end, and returnTo is safe. One residual of the class remains, F-DG2-530: a write of A's still in flight across an identity change is written into B's cache by the page's success handler. Every required check ran and passed: typecheck, build, lint, openapi:lint (161 ops), no-cdn, format, unit tests 866/866 on Node 22 and 24 and under load, integration 612/612 in both locales, AUD-403 146/146, migrations 0001-0019, and historical DG0/DG1. The only non-zero exits are the class probe's single by-design X3 assertion. The only warnings are benign: a Fastify FSTDEP022 deprecation, a Vite chunk-size advisory and pnpm pre-build bin links.
